notes: Creative track, project hearth-and-horizon, piece the-drum-that-filled-backwards (Thoothukudi district, Tamil Nadu, 2061; about 5,900 words plus notes; text only). Numbers worked second by second in a Python model: 10 mm throat pulls 0.22 bar at 1.5 L/s, threshold about 1.21 L/s, morning drum 180->210 L then empty 11:43; 14 mm never pulls against the field, brims the 218 L drum in about 10 min. Adversarial re-read fixed: first line contradicting Muthu having seen it, 'thirty litres each morning' vs 20/25 logged, 'Year Ten' to Indian 'Class Ten', far-row ratio (now sqrt(0.55) about three quarters), 25 L not 20 L in the first quarter hour. Easter 2061 = 10 April, 1 May Third Sunday of Easter Year C (John 21). Verification: node --test in the venture 20/20; check_posts ok; run_workflow_locally --for-changes 11/11 selected workflows passed (uses: steps, deploys and cross-review bots not run locally). PR CI also running with runners.
